rilua 0.1.27, vendored for atlantis4-script (Atlantis Evolution's Lua 5.1
scripts).

Origin: https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/rilua/0.1.27/download
SHA-256 of the .crate: 275971987852cab64d21d060e310b52982a7d9ffbac51acd654a1fd47ebad28b
Upstream: https://github.com/wowemulation-dev/rilua
Licence: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE), unchanged.

Kept from the package: Cargo.toml (as published), Cargo.toml.orig,
Cargo.lock, the licences, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, src/, tests/,
examples/, benches/. Left out: repository tooling (.github, .cargo,
.config, docs, scripts, rust-toolchain.toml and dot files).

The crate is excluded from the Native workspace (its dev-dependencies stay
out of Native's lock file). Its own test suite runs from this directory:
  cargo test --manifest-path vendor/rilua/Cargo.toml

Changes made in Native, each in its own commit with a reproducer test in
crates/atlantis4-script/tests/table_order.rs, so that tables iterate in
PUC-Rio Lua 5.1.4's order: see PATCHES below.
